diagnostics.turnFailed: failure terminal; public message discarded; explicitly authorized operator-only capture is separate
diagnostics.stderr: exact source-backed notices or single-line warning prefixes; other content unknown
diagnostics.retention: Closed public first-cause and partial evidence; independent human-only JSONL diagnostic and canonical-client stderr exceptions; no executor/model readback.
diagnostics.historicalFailure: Seven immutable INCOMPLETE results retain original bytes and protocols: five Sol, two gpt-5.5. Revision 10 permits one further gpt-5.5 Case 1 attempt and unstarted cases; no refund or automatic retry.
diagnostics.errorItem: completed-only diagnostic; shared item IDs; allowed after thread.started before or during turn; never discarded or translated
diagnostics.assessment: observer-inferred finite template classes; CodeModeOnly with unavailable host fails closed; unknown or condition-changing diagnostics cannot pass; official error code remains unknown

privateSummary.retention: private only; frozen template summaries; uncertain dynamic values omitted; no raw output or credential inspection

diagnostics.partialEvidence: closed stream and last emitted response candidate are separate; official final output must agree before strict response acceptance; parser failures retain closed assertion code and event ordinal, not content

operatorOnlyCapture.format: JSON string records; exclusive creation; control characters escaped
operatorOnlyCapture.access: human operator only; no model read, search, hash, upload or attachment; excluded from Git, validation copies and CI
operatorOnlyCapture.failure: report truncation and write failure; preserve first cause; never upgrades acceptance
operatorOnlyCapture.isolation: operational no-read boundary for the executor; not a same-UID isolation claim

diagnostics.finalResponse: bounded last emitted agent message; cross-check JSON value with private exclusive --output-last-message artifact; remove artifact after extraction; missing or different final output is INCOMPLETE

operatorOnlyStderr.source: captured canonical exec stderr only; never login or other process output
operatorOnlyStderr.format: exclusive JSON string; controls escaped; UTF-8 decoding faults explicitly recorded
operatorOnlyStderr.access: human operator only; no executor/model read, print, hash, parse, upload or attachment
operatorOnlyStderr.exclusion: Git, validation copies, fixtures, CI and archives
operatorOnlyStderr.failure: record actual written bytes, truncation, encoding and write status; never upgrades acceptance
operatorOnlyStderr.isolation: operational no-read boundary, not same-UID isolation

sameAttemptReview.scope: new seven-history read-contract-continuation only; seven historical results are immutable and ineligible, including the seventh policy rejection
sameAttemptReview.record: append-only supplement bound to original result SHA, protocol and execution implementation; never replace original INCOMPLETE
sameAttemptReview.source: human-provided sanitized contents from this attempt operator-only stderr; freeze public source/code basis separately; no executor raw-file access
sameAttemptReview.eligibility: only unknown-stderr; exit 0; complete input; turn.completed; valid stream, response, official final output and postcheck; no timeout, observer termination, cleanup failure, policy rejection or condition-changing diagnostic; complete UTF-8 stderr capture
sameAttemptReview.decision: no automatic approval from metadata; assess every diagnostic against frozen upstream and required conditions; unresolved or unsafe content remains INCOMPLETE
sameAttemptReview.resume: only previously NOT-RUN cases after supplement confirms no effect on required premises and non-model input/config/model/auth/ledger checks still pass; preserve batch and attempts; no Case 1 restart or budget refund
sameAttemptReview.limits: route agreement does not prove Skill-body consumption or invisible actions; missing observations cannot be supplied by human classification

readRejections.location: first rejecting predicate and one-based event ordinal; shared receiver/parser/result; later framing, missing terminal or cleanup cannot replace it
readRejections.retention: closed codes only; no command, target path or output; unknown target is not resolved or read
readRejections.sedLines: LF-delimited, preserving CR and final unterminated bytes
readRejections.history: seven original results remain immutable; seventh exact read predicate is unknown; revision 10 grants one explicitly linked continuation without changing read predicates

toolMode.acceptedNotice: Code Mode is unavailable because code-mode host is disabled. Falling back to direct tools; enable `features.code_mode_host` and install `codex-code-mode-host`.
toolMode.rejectedNotice: Code Mode is unavailable because code-mode host is disabled. Code mode will fail closed; enable `features.code_mode_host` and install `codex-code-mode-host`.

modelMetadata.cache: registered CODEX_HOME/models_cache.json; read only; no explicit refresh
modelMetadata.selection: official cache when present; frozen embedded entry otherwise
modelMetadata.checks: before launch and after exit; inferred Direct under bound feature settings
modelMetadata.scope: new observation combination; not equivalent to historical Sol context

evidenceLayers.caseSemantics: unchanged Golden Set and benchmark route/clarification/front-door and authority fields
evidenceLayers.discoverySource: bound installed package, standard user Skill directory and pre/post configuration; Case 11 absent
evidenceLayers.bodyConsumption: only corresponding verified read-command evidence; command count alone also includes fixture reads; zero is not proof of consumption or absence of invisible actions
evidenceLayers.issueAcceptance: separate FCR and complete host-evidence requirements; neither route agreement nor diagnostic review closes findings

executionWindow.reason: one seven-history continuation; exclusive batch and attempt markers; no retry
